tools.name: Hotel Lobby Studio

tools.name: Crontinel
tools.description: Laravel schedule and queue monitoring. Catch silent cron, queue, and agent failures before users do. Crontinel watches Laravel scheduler, Horizon queues, workers, backups, and agent runs, with Node/Python SDKs. Open core, MIT, free tier.

tools.name: SubmitMyStartup
tools.description: SubmitMyStartup is a tool for founders who need to know where to submit their startup. Add its MCP server to Claude or ChatGPT and ask where to launch your startup, use the planner for a shortlist, or read the JSON API. Behind them is a free list of startup directories, launch directories, SaaS directories and Product Hunt alternatives, with real submission results: whether each is really free, the catch, the fees and the wait. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: Exemplary AI
tools.description: Exemplary AI turns one long video or podcast into everything you publish. Paste a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram link or upload a file. It cuts short captioned clips with a virality score, transcribes in 99 languages, translates subtitles into 116, and writes posts, show notes and chapters. Free to start.

tools.name: ArnisWeb
tools.description: ArnisWeb lets Minecraft creators turn a selected OpenStreetMap area into a Minecraft Java world ZIP. It generates buildings, roads and terrain in the browser, with free daily credits and paid options. Independent service based on open-source Arnis; no AI model or official Minecraft affiliation is claimed.

tools.name: WSUP AI
tools.description: WSUP AI is a free AI character chat online. Browse AI characters by theme, open one, and start chatting with no sign up — every character replies in its own voice, can answer with AI-generated images, and any reply can be regenerated.

tools.name: Appnary
tools.description: Appnary builds Pixel Tracker for Shopify. Connect Meta, Google, TikTok (and more) pixels from one dashboard with no theme edits. Free for 1 pixel; paid plans from there. Store owners get accurate conversion tracking, cleaner ad attribution, and server side event support without touching theme code. Appnary is a Shopify app studio with more apps coming soon.

tools.name: SnapPChart
tools.description: SnapPChart is an AI chart analysis tool for day traders. Screenshot any chart from TradingView, Webull, MetaTrader, or any broker, and the AI returns a setup grade (A+ to F), entry zone, stop loss, multi-target exits, risk/reward, and a bear case. It is built for the moment right before you enter a trade.

tools.name: Ad Multiplier
tools.description: Ad Multiplier creates up to four visual variations from an existing 4–30 second video ad. Change creator, outfit, location, product or market, optionally supply reference images and retain original audio. Queue up to five sources, select 720p or 1080p, and download MP4 files or a ZIP for review and manual publishing. Paid per finished output with ad-balance packs from $9.90; no subscription.

tools.name: NexStep Digital
tools.description: NexStep Digital is a 24/7 Bengali AI chatbot for Facebook Pages in Bangladesh. It replies to customer messages and comments in natural Bengali within seconds, answering price, delivery charge and stock questions automatically, even at 3 AM. When a customer is ready to order, it collects name, address and phone number, organized in a free order dashboard. Built for Bangladeshi online sellers who lose orders to slow replies. 7-day free trial, then 500 BDT/month.

tools.name: Bottally
tools.description: Bottally is an AI marketing agent for SEO and AEO. Connect your site once and it researches your keywords, audits your pages and finds the topics your competitors cover and you don't. Then it writes and publishes one researched article to your blog every day (WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Wix, Notion, Framer, Next.js or any webhook). It tracks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews mention your brand, and matches you with real businesses for do-follow backlinks.

tools.name: AnyFileKit Image Translator
tools.description: AnyFileKit Image Translator translates the text inside a picture and draws the translation back over the original image. Drop in a screenshot, product photo, menu, scan or manga page and get the same image back in your language, layout intact. AI mode handles comic speech bubbles; Fast mode reads the picture in your browser and only sends the words. No sign-up, 5 free pages a day.

tools.name: String AI
tools.description:
String AI connects the world's leading large models.
What We Solve
When developers switch between model providers, they usually need to handle separate accounts, authentication, model naming, billing, rate limits, availability, and failure diagnosis. String AI brings these shared capabilities into one entry point, making model integration and long-term maintenance easier to control.

tools.name: videos.social
